Title: Wake with evening's freshness and vendetta

Messages.Author: TorranceCircle
Messages.Body:
Wake with Evening's Freshness

Reaction

Do not replace until your next untap phase.
Only usable by a tapped vampire. This reacting vampire can play reaction cards and attempt to block as though untapped until the current action is concluded.

Vendetta
Reaction

Brujah antitribu

Only usable when you are successfully bled for more than 2 pool.
Put this card on the acting minion. Brujah antitribu get +1 strength in combat with the minion with this card. Any ready Brujah antitribu may enter combat with this vampire as a  action. Burn this card if this minion goes to torpor.
________________________________________________________________

Vamp A bleeds Vamp B's controller. Vamp B is a tapped Brujah Antitribu. Vamp B plays Wake with Evening's Freshness and fails to block. Vamp A successfully bleeds for 3 (or more).

Can Vamp B play Vendetta as a reaction or does the WwEF effect end once the successful bleed is resolved?

Messages.Author: Reyda
Messages.Body:
Yes.
The bleed is resolved, but that does not mean that the action is concluded.
Else reactions like "touch of pain" could not be played by a waking vampire.
